hook: UNION vs UNION ALL: ek [[duplicate]] se nafrat karta hai

slides.title: UNION = [[upar-neeche]]
slides.note: Do class ki attendance list ko **ek register** mein likhna 📒

slides.title: UNION [[likho]]
slides.code:
SELECT city FROM employees
WHERE dept = 'IT'
UNION
SELECT city FROM employees
WHERE dept = 'Sales';

slides.title: Duplicate [[gayab]]
slides.note: Delhi dono mein tha, par UNION ne **sirf ek baar** rakha 🧹

slides.title: [[Rules]] yaad rakho
points: Dono queries mein **same number** of columns
ORDER BY sirf **end mein ek baar**
slides.note: Duplicate aa hi nahi sakte? **UNION ALL** lagao, free speed ⚡

slides.title: Kab [[kaunsa]]?
points: Do saal ki sales jodni → **UNION ALL**
slides.note: UNION se SUM kiya? Same amount wali rows **gayab**, total galat 😬

slides.why: 2 columns vs 1 column → **error**. Count aur type same rakho
